Evidence & scope

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

apex-swe · human annotation: The APEX-SWE v3 paper says Integration tasks were built by engineers with at least three years of experience and checked for prompt/source alignment, faithful tests without reward hacking, and a human reference solution passing all tests.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.integration-curation.v2

  • These are benchmark-author-reported construction checks, not a rerun or independent certification of every task.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

apex-swe · generated: APEX-SWE Observability tasks are converted from GitHub issue/PR pairs in repositories with at least 350 stars, screening for patches of at least 100 lines across at least three files, and adding synthetic logs plus public developer discussions to reconstruct a production-failure environment.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.observability-curation.v2

  • The environment includes normal log lines and bug symptoms; agents receive no failing unit tests and must diagnose the failure from telemetry and context.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

apex-swe · evaluates: The APEX-SWE v3 paper separates pass@1 task completion from task-specific functional, robustness and style rubrics judged against the final patch and execution logs; it states these rubric scores are not used for its leaderboard.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.quality-rubrics.v2

  • Style criteria apply only to Observability tasks. The paper’s Gemini 3 Pro judge configuration is specific to this supplementary rubric analysis.

apex-swe · access terms: The APEX-SWE v3 paper describes a released development set under a CC-BY license and an open evaluation harness; the pinned repository declares MIT for its code.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.release.v2

  • The paper’s general CC-BY wording is retained without inventing an unstated license version or transferring the code license to all source repositories.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

apex-swe · dataset size: The APEX-SWE v3 paper describes two held-out task domains with 100 Integration tasks and 100 Observability tasks, and a public fifty-task development set containing 25 of each.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.units.v2

  • The 200-task leaderboard and 50-task development set are separate evaluation scopes of one retained family.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

apex-swe · evaluates: APEX-SWE v3 uses API-facing pytest suites for Integration and fail-to-pass/pass-to-pass verification for Observability; pass@1 is averaged over three independent runs, while pass@3 records success at least once.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.apex-swe.verification.v2

  • The observability README requires all fail-to-pass and all pass-to-pass tests to pass. Code and scorer execution are not implied by this documented protocol.
